# deck-oled-desktop — synthetic fixture

Origin: constructed from the SOF-4 contract and public Steam Deck OLED facts
(Galileo DMI, SteamOS 3, gfx1033 RDNA2 renderer). No real hardware capture;
never a real capture. Covers: exact Deck OLED mapping in a KDE Wayland
desktop session (GameMode no), Flatpak Steam, stopped Steam.
